title: ml_entry_eq pool-snapshot refresher has logged ZERO passes since 11-06: the equity-native ML legs (alpaca_paper ml_entry_eq AND real-money ml_entry_eq_struct) may never get a fresh snapshot, so they cannot trade
note: FILED 2026-11-09 ~16:10Z by lane ML-ENTRY-EQ-STRUCT-LIVE on the manager's 16:04Z request. EVIDENCE (read-only; the snapshot FILE itself is NOT readable: pool_snapshot.json is in data_dir()/ml_entry_eq/, not on the diag log allowlist, and no system-action reads it). (1) journalctl ict-trader-live grep ml_entry_eq_refresher since 2026-11-06T12:00Z (filter applied on the VM before the cap): 8 rows, ALL db_lock_diag thread-stack warnings; ZERO 'ml_entry_eq_refresher bar_close=... covered=.../173 wrote=...' lines (logged at ml_entry_eq_refresher.py:115 whenever a pass runs) and ZERO 'pass failed' (line 120). That window includes Fri 11-06 16:00Z/20:00Z, Mon 11-09 13:15Z.. and decision closes where a pass should have run. (2) The thread is alive (manager's 15:13Z thread dump: sleeping at _loop:121, the end-of-loop POLL_S sleep), so the loop runs without exceptions. (3) _loop runs a pass only if _due(): ref_close (latest RTH decision close from fetch('SPY')) is not None AND now >= ref_close+150s AND (no snapshot OR snapshot.bar_close < ref_close). Silent no-pass therefore means either ref_close is None (SPY frame empty/unparseable or no hour%4==0 RTH close found) or a snapshot with bar_close >= ref_close already exists (cannot be the case with zero writes ever logged). No 'alpaca:' warnings in the trader journal since 13:15Z, so the SPY fetch is not failing loudly. (4) The builder refusal reason lives only in the returned none-package meta.reason and is never logged; audit_query strategy=ml_entry_eq and ml_entry_eq_struct since 11-01: 0 rows each. CAVEAT: the 16:00Z bar's pass can legitimately still be running at 16:07Z (150 s settle + up to 240 s poll + ~2 min of paced fetches); re-check the journal after ~16:15Z: a 'bar_close=2026-11-09T16:00 ... wrote=True' line would mean the mechanism works and the earlier silence was something narrower. IMPACT: if confirmed, the real-money ml_entry_eq_struct cannot trade (no fresh snapshot => pool_snapshot_stale/missing every tick) and neither can the paper leg; no money at risk, but the evidence-backed leg is inert. NEXT (needs the manager's word, no code changed): add a log line on ref_close None and on each builder refusal reason (Tier 1/2 observability), or a read surface for the snapshot (bar_close, age, covered). UPDATE 2026-11-09 16:16:32Z (the 16:12Z watch): the caveat is RESOLVED against the refresher. 16.5 min after the 16:00Z decision close (settle 150 s + <=240 s poll => a pass should have started by ~16:07Z) there is STILL no 'ml_entry_eq_refresher bar_close=... wrote=...' line (0 non-db_lock rows since 15:55Z; 399 ml_entry_eq rows are all builder 'no actionable signal'), no 'pass failed', no ERROR/Traceback, and 0 order_packages rows for ml_entry_eq* in the 400-row read (newest package of any strategy 16:02:14Z). Together with 0 pass lines since 11-06 12:00Z (incl. Fri 16:00Z/20:00Z) this is now CONFIRMED enough to treat as a live bug: no snapshot pass completes. Two remaining explanations the logs cannot separate: (a) ref_close is None every poll (SPY frame unusable / no hour%4==0 RTH close), (b) a pass STARTS but never returns (refresh_once stuck in a long paced fetch or Alpaca cooldown; the pass line is logged only on completion). A thread dump DURING a pass window (e.g. 16:05-16:15Z or 20:05-20:15Z) would tell them apart: sleeping at _loop:121 = (a); inside refresh_once/_get = (b). NO CODE CHANGED. 2026-11-09 17:46Z lane REFRESHER: #24555 merged 195fb66 and live (trader pid 2155152 restarted ~17:2xZ). VERIFIED (observed): journal 17:30:33Z 'ml_entry_eq_refresher poll: current snapshot_bar_close=2026-11-09T16:00:00+00:00 ref_close=2026-11-09 16:00:00+00:00 covered=168/173' => the refresher WORKS: a current 16:00Z snapshot exists, 168/173 covered (>=0.80). So the legs score and are simply SELECTIVE: 0 packages is the model saying no at this bar, not a pipeline fault. NOT established: why no 'bar_close=... wrote=' line was ever seen before the restart (the snapshot was current, so a pass did complete; candidate: that INFO line was missed by the earlier greps or logged by a prior process). No further fix needed for the mechanism; remaining check: at the 20:00Z close confirm a fresh 'poll: due' then 'bar_close=... wrote=True' line and that some symbol scores >= tau eventually. No tau change (Tier 3). 2026-11-09 20:36Z lane REFRESHER FINAL (observed at the 20:00Z close, trader pid 2207422 on 195fb66): 20:04:07Z 'poll: due snapshot_bar_close=16:00Z ref_close=20:00Z' -> 20:15:05Z 'bar_close=2026-11-09T20:00:00+00:00 covered=168/173 wrote=True' -> 20:19:08Z 'poll: current'. Until the snapshot is written (poll starts ~4 min after the close: SETTLE 150s + POLL 240s) the legs refuse pool_snapshot_stale (9 struct + 10 eq at ~20:05-20:12Z). The earlier 'silence' (no pass lines) is NOT explained by this evidence: I did not establish it.
